_comment: Pterodactyl v2 Egg for s&box Dedicated Server (Steam App 1892930). IMPORTANT: The hypervisor/VM running Pterodactyl Wings MUST expose x86-64-v3 (SSE4.2 + AVX2) CPU flags (e.g. Proxmox CPU type 'host'). Default 'kvm64' fails with SIGILL (exit code 132).
name: s&box Dedicated Server
author: info@sboxlist.com
description: s&box Dedicated Server (Steam App 1892930) with Steam SDK64 setup, disk-backed TMPDIR, 'game.load success' startup detection, and clean SIGINT (^C) shutdown. Requires x86-64-v3 / AVX2 CPU flags on the Wings host.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y lib32gcc-s1 curl tar ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps /mnt/server/.tmp
export HOME=/mnt/server
export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/.tmp
curl -sSL -o /mnt/server/.tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf /mnt/server/.tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
rm -f /mnt/server/.tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 1892930 validate +quit
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -f /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
cp -f /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
chmod +x /mnt/server/sbox-server
rm -rf /mnt/server/.tmp/*

variables.name: Game Package or .sbproj
variables.description: Package ident (e.g. facepunch.sandbox) or path to a local .sbproj.

variables.name: Map Package
variables.description: Optional map package (e.g. facepunch.flatgrass). Leave blank when loading a project with its own StartupScene.

variables.name: Server Hostname
variables.description: Public server name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: UDP query port (+net_query_port, engine default 27016). Assign a second port allocation on the server.

variables.name: Steam Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Optional Steam Game Server Token (+net_game_server_token) from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for public Steam master list visibility.
